subtopic: 04 · Graphs and Periodicity of Trigonometric Functions
title: Counting solutions and reading an inequality off the graph

board_content.text: Example 6 — how many solutions of |sin x| = |cos x| in [0, 2π]?
$|\sin x|=|\cos x| \iff |\tan x|=1$, the four points where the two 'tent' graphs cross.
Draw the line $y=\tfrac12$ and shade where the sine curve sits on or above it, between its two crossings.
General solution: x ∈ [2nπ + π/6, 2nπ + 5π/6], n an integer.

segments_english.text: Graphs are the fastest way to count solutions and solve inequalities.
How many x in zero to two pi satisfy absolute sine equals absolute cosine? Divide through and it becomes the absolute value of tangent equals one, the points where the two tent-shaped graphs cross.
Those are pi over four, three pi over four, five pi over four, and seven pi over four, four solutions in one lap.
Example seven, an inequality: solve sine x at least one half on zero to two pi.
Draw the horizontal line y equals one half, and shade every place the sine curve sits on or above it. That's the stretch between its two crossing points.
Reading it off, x runs from pi over six to five pi over six, inclusive.
And by periodicity the general answer repeats every full turn: x lies between two n pi plus pi over six and two n pi plus five pi over six, for any integer n.

segments_hinglish.text: Graphs solutions गिनने और inequalities solve करने का सबसे तेज़ तरीक़ा हैं.
Zero से two pi में कितने x satisfy करते हैं absolute sine equals absolute cosine? Divide कीजिए और बनता है absolute value of tangent equals one, वो points जहाँ दोनों tent-shaped graphs cross करते हैं.
वो हैं pi over four, three pi over four, five pi over four, और seven pi over four, एक lap में four solutions.
Example सात, एक inequality: solve कीजिए sine x कम से कम one half, zero से two pi पर.
Horizontal line y equals one half खींचिए, और हर वो जगह shade कीजिए जहाँ sine curve उस पर या ऊपर बैठा है. वो है इसके दो crossing points के बीच का हिस्सा.
पढ़ने पर, x चलता है pi over six से five pi over six तक, दोनों शामिल.
और periodicity से general answer हर full turn पर repeat: x होता है two n pi plus pi over six और two n pi plus five pi over six के बीच, किसी भी integer n के लिए.
